definitions.replacement_implemented: True only for an operational replacement of the complete scoped mechanism, including required migration/authority; partial source implementation or sandbox proof is insufficient. All rows remain false in this evidence set.
definitions.bootstrap_still_operating: Retained authority, enabled service/profile, resident dependency or still-available tooling, as source-recorded; not a claim each module/process is executing or that a dormant grant authorizes new work.
definitions.NEVER_FIRED: Report shorthand for no demonstrated prevented failure in reviewed evidence, not proof the mechanism never executed. Joint protections and negative controls are labelled explicitly.
definitions.evidence: Paths plus section/JSON locators, with full source hashes in provenance. Findings are audit inferences; historical timings/test results are not rerun claims.

transition_policy: Dependency order is necessary, not authorization. Obtain coordinator review and exact operational authority before any action; this phase executes no transition. Retained controls have conditional replacement gates, not calendar deadlines. Steps on independent branches may be considered independently; decisions block only dependent work.
findings: SWF-21 Wave 1 purpose is complete, but its live-profile expiry is not proven; formal scope closure must never be treated as Wave 2 authority.
Participant attribution of PY-06 recovery to SWF-29 conflicts with the decision: recovery preceded the rule. PY-09 suppression is the demonstrated protection.
Participant low-value Windows retirement recommendation is unsupported: delivery is not human receipt and absence of proof does not authorize removal.
Tunnel temporary label does not override PY-10 explicit nondismantling closure contract.

External modules have partial prose authority and reported tests; absence of repository-controlled code and suite provenance is the precise custody gap, not proof that every module is ungoverned or untested.
Checkpoint continuity and multi-BIU tenure benefit are unproven. Program-state reconstruction proof is not a coordinator-handover proof.
PRODUCER exception outlived PY-09 authority; use by later producers does not ratify it. Reversion is a recommendation only.
